series.name: Flag Wars
series.tagline: 1 comment = 1 flag. Who conquers the world?

episodes.title: Day 4: Germany vs Romania tied 19-19
episodes.summary: 118 countries claimed, 77 still open. USA took #2 from Czechia. New founders: Cuba, Puerto Rico, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Bolivia, Luxembourg, Burkina Faso, Thailand, Mongolia, Palau, Tuvalu. Who wins tomorrow?

episodes.title: Day 3: 537 flags. The world fills up
episodes.summary: 231 new flags in one day. India leads, the United States and Czechia fight for #2. Which country next?

episodes.title: Day 2: 305 flags, 94 countries in one night. Who leads?
episodes.summary: Yesterday 1 flag, today 305 flags across 94 countries. India leads with 20 flags and reaches LV2. Top 3: India 20, Czechia 17, United States 14. Italy, Romania, Germany and Poland also reach LV2. Canada at 7/10. 101 countries still unclaimed. Which country next?

episodes.title: Who conquers the world?
episodes.summary: The globe is empty. One comment plants one flag.
